description: This PHP class 'XmlParser' provides methods for parsing XML responses according to AWS REST-XML and Query protocols. It handles different shapes like structures, lists, maps, and various data types, converting XML data into PHP arrays or objects.

classes.name: XmlParser
classes.description: Implements XML parsing for REST-XML and Query AWS protocols, supporting structures, lists, maps, and primitive types.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Entry point to parse a structure shape with a SimpleXMLElement.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches XML parsing based on the shape's type (structure, list, map, etc.).

methods.name: parse_structure
methods.description: Parses a structure shape from a SimpleXMLElement.

methods.name: memberKey
methods.description: Determines the XML node name for a shape's member.

methods.name: parse_list
methods.description: Parses a list shape from XML data.

methods.name: parse_map
methods.description: Parses a map shape from XML data.

methods.name: parse_blob
methods.description: Decodes a base64-encoded blob from XML.

methods.name: parse_timestamp
methods.description: Converts XML value to DateTimeResult object, handling timestamps.

methods.name: parse_xml_attribute
methods.description: Extracts XML attribute value based on namespace and prefix.
